Part 1 必考 地点 PLACE

Hometown

家乡

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Where is your hometown?

My hometown is Shenzhen, a first-tier city in the south of China, next to Hong Kong. I've lived here my whole life, so it really feels like home, and honestly, I can't imagine living anywhere else.

深圳是一线城市，毗邻香港；从小住在这里，感觉就像家一样。

Q2Is that a big city or a small place?

It's a huge city, one of the biggest in China, with skyscrapers everywhere. The thing is, it feels young and modern rather than old and crowded, which I quite like. More than seventeen million people live here.

深圳是中国最大的城市之一，高楼林立；但感觉年轻现代不老旧，人口超一千七百万。

Q3Please describe your hometown a little.

Well, Shenzhen is a modern coastal city in southern China, famous for its tech industry. There's a seaside area in Bao'an with the tallest ferris wheel in Asia, at Bay Glory, and I love spending weekends there.

深圳是南方现代沿海城市，科技产业发达；宝安欢乐港湾有亚洲最高摩天轮，周末常去。

Q4How long have you been living there?

I've lived in Shenzhen my entire life, actually, so around twenty years now, since I was born here. My parents moved to the city before I was born, and we've never really thought about leaving since then.

出生起就住在深圳约二十年；父母在出生前搬来，从没想过离开。

Q5Do you think you will continue living there for a long time?

Yes, definitely. I'm planning to stay in Shenzhen after graduation because all my friends are here and the job opportunities are great. Honestly, I can't see myself settling down anywhere else in the future.

毕业后打算留在深圳，朋友都在、机会多；未来想在深圳定居。

Q6Do you like your hometown?

Oh, absolutely, I do. I mean, it's where I grew up, so I have a really strong attachment to it. Even the little things, like the food and the weather, make me happy about living there.

非常喜欢；深圳是长大的地方，有深厚感情，连食物和天气都让人开心。

Q7Do you like living there?

To be honest, I really enjoy it. Life there is super convenient, the transport is efficient, and the city is always full of energy. There's always something new to explore, like a fresh restaurant opening every week.

生活很方便，交通高效，城市有活力；总有新东西可探索。

Q8What do you like (most) about your hometown?

The thing I value most is how developed the infrastructure is, like the metro, hospitals and schools are all within easy reach. On top of that, the weather stays mild all year, so it's never really cold.

最看重基础设施发达，地铁医院学校都近；且全年天气温和不太冷。

Q9Is there anything you dislike about it?

Well, not much comes to mind, because I really do love living there. If I had to pick something, it'd be the cost of living, which is pretty high, and the summers can get uncomfortably hot and humid.

很难挑毛病；若要选，就是生活成本高，夏天又热又潮湿。

Q10What's your hometown famous for?

Shenzhen is famous for its tech industry, with companies like Tencent based there and Ma Huateng, its founder, as a local legend. It's also known for Deng Xiaoping's special economic zone, which turned a fishing village into a global city.

以科技产业闻名，腾讯总部在此、马化腾是本地名人；也是邓小平经济特区，由渔村变全球都市。

Q11Did you learn about the history of your hometown at school?

Yeah, we actually did cover it in history class. I remember learning that Shenzhen used to be a small fishing village until it became a special economic zone, which is pretty amazing when you look at how it looks today.

历史课学过深圳从渔村变成经济特区的历史，对比今天很惊人。

Q12Are there many young people in your hometown?

Oh, definitely, tons of them. Shenzhen is known as a young city, you know, full of university graduates who move there for work. Walking around the streets, I often feel like most people I see are under thirty.

年轻人数不胜数；深圳是座年轻城市，毕业生都来工作，街上大多是三十岁以下。

Q13Is your hometown a good place for young people to pursue their careers?

Definitely, it's one of the best. The job market is huge, especially in tech and finance, and salaries are high compared to other cities. That's why so many young people move to Shenzhen to chase their dreams.

绝对是很好的选择；就业市场大，科技金融机会多、工资高，适合追梦。

Q14Have you learned anything about the history of your hometown?

Yeah, quite a lot, actually. The most interesting thing I picked up is that Shenzhen was just a fishing village forty years ago, and now it's a massive international city. That transformation fascinates me.

学过不少；最感兴趣的是深圳四十年前还是渔村，如今已是国际化大都市。

Q15Did you learn about the culture of your hometown in your childhood?

Hmm, to some extent, yes. At school we learned that Shenzhen is a city of migrants, so its culture is quite open and diverse. Growing up, I also experienced that blend of Cantonese and modern city culture myself.

童年学过深圳是移民城市，文化开放多元；亲身感受过粤语文化与现代都市文化交融。
